constructedNote: Axes tagged P/anticipatory-application are assembled by this cluster from units that do not cite one another on the point. They are the cluster's own analytical contribution, not a dispute the sources stage themselves.

axes.label: boredom-as-deficit <-> boredom-as-functional/adaptive
axes.resolution: Not a verdict but a partition: state boredom is functional/adaptive (pain-capacity analogy, bor-sec-26 p.327); trait boredom/boredom proneness remains harmful but is reframed as a dysfunction of the same mechanism (bor-sec-26 p.333 n.5). This reconciles the deficit literature rather than refuting it.
axes.misuse_warning: Citing 'Elpidorou says boredom is good' without the state/trait partition miscites him.

independent_arrivals.note: Slaby reconstructs Heidegger's 'telling refusal is a telling' (proto-functional) then judges the activist payoff over-extended; does not cite the regulatory literature.
Darling's predictive processing supplies a candidate mechanism for what Elpidorou motivates.

live_objection.note: Hughes treats the functional turn as a departure from Heidegger's project, not a development of it (p.6 n.9). Gibbs's 'positive attunement' is existential-disclosive, NOT evolutionary-adaptive, and must not be conflated with the regulatory account.

axes.label: profound boredom is boredom <-> profound boredom is a distinct existential mood
axes.resolution: E&F construct the sui-generis reading from Heidegger's own formal-indication remarks (p.16), then reject it with four counter-arguments (pp.17-20), landing on a QUALIFIED continuity: continuous with and conditioned by ordinary boredom (FCM 156, p.19) but identical to neither state nor trait boredom (pp.9-15).
axes.key_argument: Profound boredom and trait boredom share the feature of being totalizing but have opposite existential valence: trait boredom is incapacitating/despair-inducing (Bargdill/Maltsberger testimonies); profound boredom is motivating/authenticity-disclosing (pp.14-15, 22).
axes.unresolved_note: The Heideggerian units largely do not answer the challenge; Quaranta footnotes the thesis (p.35) without engaging it. The debate is one-sided in the literature, not settled.

axes.label: angst <-> profound boredom as the Grundstimmung
axes.resolution: A periodizing question, not merely doctrinal: 'Grundstimmung' appears only ONCE in Being and Time and becomes central only after 1929 (bor-sec-02). Withy supplies the only affirmative case for boredom, with page-precise support at FCM 143 (Anrufen) and FCM 165 (bor-sec-51).
axes.see_also: DA-10 (the sharpest evidence is negative and intra-volume)

axes.label: self-report <-> physiological marker as ground truth

evidence_for_dissociation.finding: All 13 analyzed participants showed temporally coincident EEG-and-gaze boredom regions, while self-report (mean 6.38/9) correlated significantly with NO physiological feature.
Directional fractionation hypothesis: subjective low arousal may coexist with autonomic high arousal, reconciling contradictory HR findings (London 1972 increased vs Pattyn 2008 decreased).
The paper's stated rule ('high pupil diameter ratio indicates boredom') is contradicted in sign by its own correlation tables.
Implicit gaze/pupil measures at times outperform explicit self-report for memory confidence; metacognition is in principle opaque to the reporting subject.

axes.resolution: The cluster refuses the framing (P/anticipatory-application). A Grundstimmung is awakened, not ascertained (fcm-03); Hadjioannou independently makes the same argument-form for angst -- reflective access distorts the affect it targets (bor-sec-48). If so, self-report is not a noisy channel onto a hidden state but a different kind of act, and the dissociation is predicted rather than anomalous.
axes.part_iii_consequence: A design that validates EEG/gaze AGAINST self-report assumes the answer to a question this cluster documents as open. Report both channels; do not silently treat either as criterion. This is the cluster's single most actionable finding.

axes.label: EEG frontal-asymmetry-as-boredom-marker <-> confound-with-arousal

evidence.finding: Uses F4-F3 alpha as the boredom index; leftward FEA shift across a boring task correlates with low trait boredom (r=-.48, -.47, p<.01), frontally specific, reference-montage robust (N=54). Never discusses arousal or confound anywhere -- verified by direct search of the source.
Alpha is a global arousal marker: ~40% power reduction eyes-closed to eyes-open, spatially uniform across all sites, co-varying with skin-conductance level (N=28). Never mentions boredom.
DASM/RASM asymmetry features were rarely selected by the Wrapper Subset Evaluator; gamma/beta features carried the boredom signal instead (N=28).

axes.resolution: Barry gives a mechanism by which an alpha-derived index could track arousal rather than boredom; Seo gives feature-selection evidence that asymmetry is not what a classifier picks for boredom; Perone relies on the index without addressing either. Perone's own null on Hypothesis 1 is consistent with the caution.
axes.part_iii_consequence: Any FEA-based boredom index needs an arousal control (skin conductance or equivalent) and an explicit baseline rationale. Note bor-sec-33 (the most Part-III-relevant EEG study) uses NO resting baseline at all -- both conditions are active eyes-open viewing -- sidestepping rather than answering Barry's caution.

axes.label: boredom as unified construct <-> heterogeneous family
axes.resolution: Raffaelli et al. do NOT resolve to either pole. Field-wide inconsistency (arousal direction, fMRI regions) is compatible either with non-standardized operationalization of one construct or with genuine subtype heterogeneity. Their forward recommendation -- an empirically validated taxonomy (abstract p.2451; Conclusion p.2460) -- commits them to taking heterogeneity seriously as the more novel hypothesis, while explicit hedging keeps them short of asserting it.
axes.other_positions: Darling dissolves rather than adjudicates: emotion and mood are levels of one hierarchy differing in timescale, not distinct kinds (pp.3, 20). Feldges & Pieczenko attack taxonomically: Gotz & Frenzel's four-type model conflates antecedent (indifferent), core (calibrating), and resultant (searching/reactant) states (pp.9-10).

axes.label: monotony/environment-caused <-> meaning/agent-caused
axes.resolution: The asymmetry is internal to the canonical account: the FIRST form is caused 'from outside' by a determinate boring thing, while the SECOND and THIRD 'arise from out of Dasein itself' -- an unresolved but load-bearing asymmetry in the increasing-depth story (bor-sec-03, pp.679-680). The canonical account therefore contains both poles and distributes them across the forms rather than choosing. Hughes lands on a genuine hybrid: pandemic boredom is primarily environment-caused, yet its residual significance is agent/situation-relative (bor-sec-08, pp.9-12).

axes.label: individually structured <-> collectively induced boredom

evidence.finding: Heidegger's account presupposes that being-withdrawn from the world depends on others remaining absorbed in it; a society-wide simultaneous withdrawal (lockdown) has no place in his individualist framework (p.11 n.13).
Documents Heidegger reframing profound boredom's Grundstimmung as a Volk-level communal attunement whose demand is collective self-founding rather than individual resoluteness.
Sociologizes the ostensibly trait-like fundamental attunement as leisure-economy-produced without abandoning the ontological register (pp.316-324).

axes.resolution: Hughes identifies the structural gap; Slaby & Thonhauser show the historical Heidegger DID scale the analysis up -- into a Volk-attunement, in the Rektoratszeit texts. That is simultaneously an answer to the scaling question and a warning about the answer's provenance.
axes.part_iii_consequence: Part III's subjects are boredom-in-a-cohort (a class, a VLE session, a shared VR deployment). The canonical phenomenological account is individualist by construction; take the collective account from Hughes's structural critique rather than from Heidegger's own Volk-level answer (see DA-11).

axes.label: boredom as mood (non-intentional) <-> boredom as emotion (object-directed)
axes.resolution: Not a quibble: the entire regulatory account presupposes boredom is an EMOTION (something with an object and a function), which is exactly what the Heideggerian account denies. The philosophical camp treats boredom as a mood on Prinz's intentionality criterion; educational psychology collapses moods into 'low-intensity emotions' (bor-sec-16, pp.3-4, 11).
axes.underlying_translation_problem: Befindlichkeit has at least EIGHT competing English renderings (state-of-mind, disposition/disposedness, ontological disposition, findingness, affectedness/affectivity, situatedness, attunement, or untranslated), with E&F electing the last (bor-sec-02, p.663 n.4). Whether fear is a mood or an object-directed emotion is contested even within Being and Time scholarship (p.668).

axes.label: whether boredom is even a candidate for the authenticity role
axes.sharpest_evidence: Both units are chapters of the SAME book (Hadjioannou ed., Heidegger on Affect, 2019), twenty pages apart.

evidence.finding: McManus's footnote 35 (p.148) treats angst as the authenticity-relevant Grundstimmung still owed a full account -- without ever raising boredom as a candidate.
Ch. 8 of the same volume argues profound boredom is motivating and authenticity-disclosing (pp.14-15, 22).
Ch. 7 gives the affirmative case for boredom in the Grundbefindlichkeit role (FCM 143, FCM 165).

axes.resolution: Not a disagreement but a talking-past. McManus is not arguing against boredom's candidacy; boredom simply does not appear in his field of candidates. This is evidence about the state of the literature rather than about boredom: even in a volume containing a dedicated chapter arguing profound boredom's authenticity-disclosing role, the authenticity-and-affect chapter defaults to angst without comment. The volume contains the thesis, the counter-default, and the bridge, without any of the three engaging the others.

axes.label: Heidegger's philosophy <-> Heidegger's politics
axes.resolution: Mansikka footnotes the 'danger' of giving positive meaning to Heidegger's 'strength and power' given his Nazism (via Ott 1993) and brackets the political question (pp.264-265 n.6). Against that: Slaby argues the activist construal of profound boredom is not required by the phenomenon itself but reflects and later feeds Heidegger's political-existential temperament (bor-sec-12, pp.242-246); Slaby & Thonhauser show the Volk-attunement reframing operating in the Rektoratszeit texts (bor-sec-55); Vallega-Neu interrogates Heidegger's Nazism against his own claimed capacity to 'ward off' distortion through vigilance (bor-sec-52).
axes.cluster_position: (P/anticipatory-application) Forced by DA-08: the collective scaling of boredom's Grundstimmung -- which Part III needs, since its subjects are cohorts -- is exactly the move that runs through Heidegger's most politically compromised material. Not a reason to avoid it; a reason to take the collective account from Hughes's structural critique rather than from Heidegger's own Volk-level answer.
